I've replied to Dana in their DM. I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files, and two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers come up:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`, 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in Eau Claire weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and the note says the logs should be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). It covers gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 that weren't reading trailer tags. The note says it was escalated to tier-2.

I raised two things for Dana to check before the list goes in the weekly notes:
- **The #4419 descriptions don't match.** Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 (not one of Moss's) also lists #4419, but calls it "Gate 3 printer lag", a printout delay that had already been patched. That's a different problem from Moss's scanner issue, so the ticket itself needs checking.
- **The cheat sheet has no date**, so I can't say how current the #4419 status is.

Moss's two Central notes also list tickets #4409 and #4412, but those belong to Pree's dealer account, not Quarrendon, so I left them out.

I only used shared files that Dana can open, and didn't read any channels for this. No approval was needed, because ticket numbers count as operational facts the account team can see.
